LightningComponentBundle.description: Shows a long text field as rendered Markdown with editing in place, such as a customer brief or underwriting notes.

property.name: fieldApiName
property.label: Field API name
property.description: The long text field to show, for example Customer_Brief__c.

property.name: hideWhenEmpty
property.label: Hide when empty
property.description: Draw nothing while the field is empty.
